experiment: full temporary arm; 40ms settle, 200ms ramp, 160ms hold; no release

controller.feedforward: bias - passive, evaluated on copied current state

sampling: Includes t=0 and every post-step state; contacts refreshed on separate MjData.
distance_caveat: Some mj_geomDistance queries may return zero without a matching contact. Preserve raw values; do not interpret as proven touching or claim continuous positive clearance from this query alone.
limitations: Temporary fixtures/exclusions, zero finger margin and implicitfast; 1 nm is a numerical zero diagnostic, not hardware tolerance. No release, upper-limit loading, or task success validated. Press-mode bounds [-0.1,5.1]mm are diagnostic guards, not hardware tolerances.
observer_note: Independent model; diagnostic margin=gap=5mm. Positive records are proximity only. Observer constraints, if any during overlap, do not feed back to main data. No claim of exact observer distances during penetration.
